footprint.symmetry: bilaterally symmetric along the long center axis (front-back symmetry)

raw_elements: windows (none visible / possible open slits under roof overhangs)
entrance (centered on one short side with two-step slab porch)
roof (three stepped overhanging slab layers with a central rectangular hole)
decorative wooden horizontal band around mid-wall
raw_hints: Start with a rectangular stonebrick wall base ~9x13 blocks footprint, 2-3 blocks tall.
Add a continuous horizontal strip of wooden planks around the mid-height on the front and sides aligned with images.
Place glowstone blocks at the front upper corners embedded in the stonebrick trim.
Build three progressively smaller overhanging stone slab layers centered on the footprint to create the stepped roof; leave a central rectangular opening through the top two layers.
Create a centered entrance on the front short side with two slab steps outward (stone slabs) and a wooden slab as the outermost face.
rebuild_intent.summary: Small single-story rectangular pavilion with layered stepped slab roof. Exterior walls are primarily stone-brick blocks with a horizontal band of wooden planks and glowstone corner lights. Roof consists of multiple overhanging stone slab tiers with a central rectangular opening. Entrance centered on one short side with a small slab porch.
